column1: # MacChromiumAccessibility: async renderer admission uses macSettle's two-second patience; every descendant event wakes the content judge, and only exposed content proves readiness. Missing observation is reported and still permits activation; synchronous reads never sleep. Silence is settle_unobserved, not readiness or failure.

# VolumeIO: timeout_retry_deadline uses ContinuationOnce/TaskWaitDeadline's existing sleeper; a 30-second default ceiling applies only without an inherited deadline. No new timer primitive; issued filesystem work retains completion and cleanup on the serial queue.

# deep-r2-embeddings (2026-11-01): no timer primitive, duration, polling, retry or wait-ceiling changes. Action fills retain coalesced owner wakes and eight-text chunks; per-text failures settle as named gaps. Doctor adds one prediction to its existing check without scheduling work.

# deep-r2-embeddings fix round (2026-11-01): no timer, duration or deadline changes. Doctor repair of a recorded refusal joins the existing coalesced epoch-convergence flight; it adds no polling or scheduled retry.

# deep-chrome-page2 (2026-11-01): trusted input retains the existing 20-second timeout_retry_deadline at background trustedInput and page inputTargets; expiry stops further effects and still reads/releases the exact retained target and detaches once. Removed page typing's every-32-code-point task yield. Explicit delay_ms uses waitInputDelay (0..250 ms between acknowledged code points), an event_deadline for the requested next-input time cancelled by the existing activeRequestWaits owner; no default per-character loop, new polling or retry timer. The app's existing request deadline/cancellation bounds its wait if Chrome never replies, reporting unknown; the extension still owes the in-flight command and finally cleanup when Chrome settles it.

# deep-desk2 (2026-11-01): no timer primitive or duration changes. Existing event-driven news release keeps the 12-hour rest, scoped to the current filed condition under the Desk lock; an absent signal/news edge leaves work waiting. Snooze labels now say Through the inclusive bare day; their stored days and resume boundaries are unchanged. Checkpoint/hold cleanup uses no new waits or retries.

# deep-scheduler (2026-11-02): no timer primitive, cadence, cap or duration changes. Trigger admission locks configuration then state; current civil keys replace reconstruction. Workshop deadline discovery now owes/settles its checked configuration read just as inbox discovery does. Unavailable discovery contributes no deadline; source/repair invalidation and the existing integrity sweep remain the wake boundaries. Diary receipt backfill no longer advances a job's clock.

# deep-turn-context (2026-11-02): timeout_retry_deadline behavior only; existing attention deadline now fails preparation instead of supplying empty inputs. Semantic preparation consumes the existing checked 500ms ticket wait; expiry ends only waiting, and NativeContextFlowRuntime retains the embedding read to settlement. No timer primitive, interval, polling or duration added/changed.

# deep-notifications2 (2026-11-02): timeout_retry_deadline at AttentionRouter+MacNotifications.swift:205 uses ContinuationOnce/TaskWaitDeadline; wait ends at the earlier inherited deadline or five seconds. Expiry leaves the retained OS operation alive to settle its original ledger row; Stop cancels unissued work and late OS callbacks still settle. Ledger/source locks have five-second admission bounds; no polling, cadence or integrity interval added.
